publication_form.rationale: No authoritative complete City program book was identified. A compilation would need to include a large heterogeneous family while preserving several independent authorization, scope, and schedule roles plus the two Streets editions. The current evidence supports transparent future component retention, not a claim that one edition is the final complete program.
